## 简体中文

### 新增

- 新增显示在任务栏图标上方的 Windows 风格应用跳转列表，提供应用、固定、快捷方式、访达和关闭操作。
- 恢复原始 Demo 的最近项目跟踪，并将捕获的项目显示在应用跳转列表顶部。

### 修复

- 恢复原始的独立快捷键管理窗口，替换不完整的新对话框。

## English

### Added

- Added Windows-style app jump lists positioned above their taskbar icons, with app, pin, shortcut, Finder, and close actions.
- Restored Recent project tracking from the original Demo behavior and showed captured items at the top of app jump lists.

### Fixed

- Restored the original standalone shortcut management window instead of the incomplete replacement dialog.
